summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Hanfu Production p02 - Production of the Top ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will create the top coat for a Hanfu garment using Marvelous Designer. Follow the step-by-step instructions to achieve the desired design. ## Setting Up the Model First, change the model pose to T-Pose. 1. Open Google and select a node. 2. Click to open the symmetry edit mode. 3. Ensure the node is named with either the left or right arrow at the beginning to enable symmetry editing. 4. Open another node and change the model pose as needed. ## Creating the Hanfu Version Now, let's create the Hanfu version of the top coat. 1. Select the multi-layer tool. 2. Click on the 2D window to establish the starting point. 3. Press the **Shift** key and move the mouse to create the edge of the sleeve. Repeat this step until the desired edge is formed. ### Completing the Sleeve Edges - When a curve is completed, release the **Ctrl** key and press it again to create a straight line. - After all lines are complete, click on the starting point to finish the creation of the board. - Press **Ctrl + D** to create a symmetrical board. ### Expanding the Collar - Select the front, middle, and back lines, then right-click and select “Expansion.” - Set the diameter to **50mm** for the collar part and click **Confirm** to finalize the expansion. ### Arranging the Boards - After selecting two boards, separate them in the 2D window; avoid overlap for easier arrangement later. - Use the hexagonal tool to draw a line and cut it. - Click on the "Rearrange 2D Position" tool to arrange the boards in the 3D window according to the placement in the 2D window. ### Adjusting the Board Dimensions - Expand the backside of the board line to match the front; no further opening is needed. - Use the "Resize Board" tool, replacing it with the Rectangle tool from the dropdown menu. - In the 2D window, click to fill the height and width of **50mm**. ## Sewing the Garment ### Setting Up the Sewing Line 1. Press the **Control D** button to create an additional board for the knockout. 2. Open Back 3D for a clearer view of the model. 3. Under the display menu, the backside of the mausoleum will show as "Top Mama." 4. Choose an alternative from "Order 2D Wheel Change" and select the stack block, adjusting its position as necessary. ### Starting the Sewing Process - After arranging, we begin sewing. Choose the sewing line in either the 2D or 3D window. - Once the single sewing machine is adjusted, the sewing line will complete in the corresponding section. ### Special Collar Considerations - The collar area is unique; visualize the seam position. The front, middle, and upper parts are adjacent to a small rectangular shape. - Sew all other parts together, including the sleeve and body, noting that this area has many straight lines. ### Creating the Seam Lines 1. Use the old sewing machine tool. Click the starting point and end point along the seam line to create the first seam. 2. Perform the same operation for the back. ### Simulation and Adjustments - After sewing, switch back to the cutting board tool and begin the simulation. - To stabilize the back, temporarily sew the top and bottom together using the sewing line tool. - Select the sewing needle tool from the dropdown menu, click, and drag to add the needle near the rectangle's corner. ## Finalizing the Design ### Adjusting the Collar - If the collar feels too wide, drag the front and middle lines inward to narrow it. Use the right button to manually enter movement values. - Adjusting the line will allow for modifications without affecting other lines. ### Enhancing the Wrinkle Effects - Reduce the clip to **11** for a more detailed wrinkle effect. Narrowing the clip enhances subtlety in the wrinkles. - Change materials and physical properties to achieve better results. For instance, opt for double-layered small-scale sand or O-gain sand for varying wrinkle textures. ### Final Adjustments - During the simulation process, adjust the corners of the side panels using the edit panel tool. Drag the points horizontally for a smooth curve. - Reduce the surface strength of the model to ensure a better fit for the Hanfu garment, lowering the overall thickness to **1** to minimize air thickness around the clothes. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching the tutorial on producing the top for a Hanfu garment using Marvelous Designer. Implement these techniques to perfect your design and enhance your skills. ```
